body.name: active local target-separating alternatives
body.construction: For \(\mathsf Q\in\mathscr Q\) and \(w>0\), let \(\mathcal S_{\mathsf Q}(w)=\{s=(P,Q):P,Q\in\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}},\ P_X=Q_X,\ \mu_a^P=\mu_a^Q\ \text{on }\mathcal X\setminus\mathsf Q\ \text{for both }a,\ P_X\{x\in\mathsf Q:\tau_P(x)\tau_Q(x)<0\}>0,\ |\theta(P)-\theta(Q)|>2w\}\). Define \(\mathscr A(w)=\{\mathsf Q\in\mathscr Q:\mathcal S_{\mathsf Q}(w)\ne\varnothing\}\); exactly these cells are active.
